reason: This Lake transition registers independent ECPP, ordered-function, real-closure, RCF, sign-determination, Yun and selected-sign semantic proof, conformance and bench targets. It adds the pinned AINTLIB dependency for ECPP proofs and enables library-level precompileModules for HexECPP and HexRealClosure. It adds HexPrimality.SqufofConformance and hexprimality_squfof_measure; removes HexRealFormulaMathlib.ProofProbe.Normalization and HexRCF.RealFormulaProbe.Support, Baseline and Adapter; removes HexPolyDet.PackedTests and HexPolyDetMathlib.PackedTests from HexStructuralTacticTests; and removes hex_poly_det_packed and the manual DeterminantExperiment/determinant_experiment targets. None of these targets, AINTLIB or the two precompiled libraries lies in the factorization service runtime import graph. The Mathlib pin, package compiler options, hexbz_factor_service executable and all factorization-library declarations are unchanged. The selected-sign registration adds only HexSignDetMathlib.SelectedProducer to HexQuerySemantics and HexSignDetMathlib.SelectedProducerConformance to HexConformance; neither target reaches the measured factorization executable.
